items.title: Frank Christian Interview, 1965-09-06
items.q: He played clarinet. He used to play with us.

ctx.x: were talking about Bill Galladay's band. Yeah, Bill used to play. You see, Bill couldn't, all the songs he used to get, he heard him a couple of times, he'd try to get him out and then play him, you see it.
